ops.body: Acceptance durability followup: current cc-sync .github/workflows/ci.yml only runs go test -race ./..., so all hermetic -tags e2e scenarios are omitted from PR CI. Once final harness/pins land, add the synthetic E2E suite to the macOS test job (ensure git-lfs is installed; GOWORK=off) so source-unavailable, metering, relay, retention, and 40-session regressions remain continuously graded. Native Claude/auth tests stay a separate manual gate. This is the existing acceptance suite, not a request for another test layer.
